strings.(아무것도 없는 공간, 혼자 있던 사이암이 누군가의 인기척을 느낀다.): (Alone in an empty space, Siam senses someone's presence.)
strings.그대는 길게 말하는 법이 없으니 내가 먼저 묻겠소. 혹시 그대 말고 같이: You're never one for many words, so I'll ask first. Did someone come with you?
strings.카즈노가 추천해서 와봤더니 기대 이상이야, 마법사 양반. 기척을 숨겼는데: Kazno recommended you, and you've exceeded my expectations, mage. You noticed me even with my presence hidden?
strings.그래, 다른 세계에서 온 마법사 양반. 나와 카즈노가 알고 싶은 게 있어: That's right, mage from another world. Kazno and I want to know something. Answer our questions, and I won't do anything.
I promise. I'm no savage beast. I won't hurt you.
strings.당신은 확실히 다른 느낌이오. 그런데 당신이 말한 약속…, 무슨 계약같은: You do feel different. But this promise you mentioned... Is it some kind of contract?
Perhaps. Perhaps not. I can offer one if you want. It depends on whom you choose and what form it takes.
Understood. Then I'll tell you about the other world you wish to know.
strings.좋아! 마법사 양반은 역시 다르네. 이미 알고 있었군. 그럼 '아▒▒엘': Good! You're something else, mage. You already knew. Then tell me about 'A▒▒el'!
A star's name I haven't heard in a long time. Where I came from...
strings.아즈라엘…. '신의 천사가 선택한 별'이라는 뜻이오. 헛, 카즈노…. 가: Azrael... It means 'the star chosen by god's angel.' Oh, Kazno... Leaving?
I'll be going. I only brought someone who had business with you.
Before I leave, may I ask one thing? The choice you made then...
Like you, I have no regrets...
Goodbye, Kazno. I'll hear more about that star from him.
strings.그리고 뱀 찾기 전엔 죽지 마. 그 커플도 다시 만나야 할 거 아냐? 아: And don't die before you find the serpent. You still need to see that couple again, don't you? Plenty left to do. Take care.
strings.(카즈노가 사라지고 오랫동안 사이암과 제릴이 대화를 나눈다. 제릴이 만족: (Kazno disappears. Siam and Jeril speak for a long time, and Jeril looks satisfied.)
strings.고마워. 덕분에 도움이 많이 됐어, 이 일이 끝나면 '에트와르'는 모두가: Thank you. That helped a great deal. When this is over, Etoile will change in the direction everyone desires.
I'm not sure what you mean...
strings.적어도 지금보다는 나을 거라는 이야기야. 어, 이번엔 나한테 묻고 싶은: At least it'll be better than now. Oh, you look like you have a question for me. Go on. What is it?
strings.혹시, 그 자도… 아가슈라인 것이오?: Is that person... also an Agasura?
Forced by fate to become a real one... Just like the one I knew.
